blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «o'z» so'ziga egalik qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi: o'z**im**, o'z**ing**, o'z**i**, o'z**imiz**, o'z**ingiz**, o'z**lari**. Ingliz tilida ham xuddi shunday so'zlar bor: **myself, yourself, himself** ... Ular ikki xil ma'noda ishlatiladi. Birinchisi — harakat bajaruvchining **o'ziga** qaytadi: I cut **myself** — o'zimni kesib oldim (boshqani emas). Ikkinchisi — **urg'u**: I made it **myself** — buni o'zim qildim (boshqa birov emas).

Yasalishi: birlikda `-self`, ko'plikda `-selves` (f → ves, xuddi knife → knives kabi). E'tibor bering: **my**self, **your**self, **our**selves (egalik olmoshi + self), lekin **him**self, **them**selves (to'ldiruvchi + self). «hisself», «theirselves» degan shakllar yo'q. **you** ning ikkita o'zlik shakli bor: bitta kishiga — **yourself**, bir necha kishiga — **yourselves**.

Agar harakatni bajaruvchi va harakat qaratilgan kishi **bir odam** bo'lsa, to'ldiruvchi o'rnida **-self** shakli keladi. Taqqoslang: Aziz hurt **him** — Aziz uni (boshqa yigitni) xafa qildi; Aziz hurt **himself** — Aziz o'zini lat yedirdi. Bu farq ayniqsa he / she / they bilan muhim, chunki **him**, **her**, **them** doim **boshqa** odamni bildiradi.

items.text: I looked at **myself** in the mirror.

blocks.text: Ba'zi fe'llar o'zlik olmoshi bilan tayyor ibora hosil qiladi. Ularni butunligicha yodlang — ko'pchiligi mehmondorchilikda va xayrlashganda eshitiladi.

rows: maza qilib dam oling, yaxshi vaqt o'tkazing

items.text: Have a good time and **enjoy yourselves**!

blocks.text: -self ishlatilmaydigan fe'llar: feel, relax, wash, meet

O'zbekchadagi ko'p o'zlik fe'llari (yuvinmoq, kiyinmoq, cho'milmoq) va «o'zimni ... his qilyapman» iborasi inglizchada **-self siz** aytiladi. **feel**: I **feel** tired — o'zimni charchagan his qilyapman («I feel myself tired» emas!). **relax**: Sit down and **relax**. **wash, shave, get dressed**: I **washed**, **shaved** and **got dressed**. **meet**: We **met** in 2010. **concentrate**: I can't **concentrate**. Bu fe'llarga **myself** qo'shish o'zbek va rus tilidan o'tgan juda keng tarqalgan xato.

items.text: He **got dressed** and left the house.

blocks.text: by myself — yolg'iz, hech kimning yordamisiz

**by myself / by yourself / by herself** ... ikki ma'noni bildiradi: «yolg'iz» (= alone): I live **by myself** — yolg'iz yashayman; va «yordamsiz, o'zi»: She built the website **by herself** — saytni o'zi (hech kimning yordamisiz) yaratdi. Gap oxiridagi oddiy **myself** ham «o'zim» degan urg'u beradi: I painted the room **myself** — xonani o'zim bo'yadim (usta chaqirmasdan). Bu o'zbekchadagi «o'zim» bilan aynan mos.

items.text: My uncle lives **by himself** in a village.

blocks.text: **themselves / ourselves** — har biri **o'zini**; **each other** — biri ikkinchisini, ya'ni «**bir-birini**», «**bir-biriga**». Bu ikkisini adashtirish ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi. O'zbekchada ham farq aniq: «o'zlarini aybladi» va «bir-birini aybladi».

rows: Tom ham, Emma ham o'zini aybladi.
We looked at **ourselves** in the mirror.

items.text: Bekzod and Aziz help **each other** with English.
items.translation: Bekzod bilan Aziz ingliz tilida **bir-biriga** yordam berishadi.

items.text: We've known **each other** for ten years.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I feel myself bad.» → **I feel bad.**; «Relax yourself!» → **Relax!**; «He hurt hisself.» → **He hurt himself.**; «yourselfs» → **yourselves**; «Help you!» (mehmonga) → **Help yourself!**; «They love themselves.» (bir-birini nazarda tutib) → **They love each other.**; «We know ourselves for ten years.» → **We've known each other for ten years.**
Eslab qolish: **-self** = «o'z-» (o'zim, o'zi, o'zlari); **each other** = «bir-biri». O'zbekchada «o'zimni ... his qilyapman» desangiz ham, inglizchada faqat **I feel ...**
Bog'lanish: I / me / my / mine jadvali — 62-dars; o'zlik olmoshi uning beshinchi ustuni. him va himself farqi to'ldiruvchi shakliga tayanadi — 59-dars.

examples.title: **myself** and **yourself**
examples.description: Harakat bajaruvchining o'ziga qaytadi: I hurt **myself** — «o'zimni lat yedirdim». Bitta kishiga — **yourself**.

sentences.text: I cut **myself** while I was making a salad.
sentences.translation: Salat tayyorlayotib **qo'limni kesib oldim**.

sentences.text: Be careful with that knife — don't hurt **yourself**!
sentences.translation: U pichoq bilan ehtiyot bo'ling — **o'zingizni** jarohatlab qo'ymang!

sentences.text: I looked at **myself** in the shop window and laughed.
sentences.translation: Do'kon oynasida **o'zimga** qaradim-u kulib yubordim.

sentences.text: Do you ever talk to **yourself**?
sentences.translation: Hech **o'zingiz bilan** gaplashasizmi?

sentences.text: After the exam I bought **myself** a new phone.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan keyin **o'zimga** yangi telefon sotib oldim.

sentences.text: Sometimes I'm angry with **myself** because I'm always late.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan **o'zimdan** jahlim chiqadi, chunki doim kechikaman.

sentences.text: Tell us something about **yourself**, Bekzod.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, bizga **o'zingiz** haqingizda biror narsa aytib bering.

sentences.text: Look after **yourself** and call me when you arrive.
sentences.translation: **O'zingizni** ehtiyot qiling va yetib borganingizda qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: I taught **myself** to play the guitar from online videos.
sentences.translation: Gitara chalishni internetdagi videolardan **o'zim** o'rgandim.

sentences.text: You should be proud of **yourself** — you did a great job!
sentences.translation: **O'zingiz** bilan faxrlansangiz arziydi — zo'r ish qildingiz!

examples.title: **himself**, **herself**, **itself**
examples.description: Erkak — **himself**, ayol — **herself**, narsa yoki hayvon — **itself**. O'zbekchada uchalasi ham «o'zi».

sentences.text: Aziz fell off his bike and hurt **himself**.
sentences.translation: Aziz velosipeddan yiqilib, **lat yedi**.

sentences.text: Madina looked at **herself** in the mirror and smiled.
sentences.translation: Madina ko'zguda **o'ziga** qarab jilmaydi.

sentences.text: This oven cleans **itself**, so it's very easy to use.
sentences.translation: Bu pech **o'zini o'zi** tozalaydi, shuning uchun undan foydalanish juda oson.

sentences.text: Tom is very shy and doesn't like talking about **himself**.
sentences.translation: Tom juda uyatchang, **o'zi** haqida gapirishni yoqtirmaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah burnt **herself** on a hot pan.
sentences.translation: Sara issiq tovaga **qo'lini kuydirib oldi**.

sentences.text: Grandad lives alone, but he looks after **himself** very well.
sentences.translation: Bobom yolg'iz yashaydi, lekin **o'ziga** juda yaxshi qaraydi.

sentences.text: Our cat washes **itself** after every meal.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz har ovqatdan keyin **o'zini** yalab tozalaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza bought **herself** a beautiful dress for the wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'y uchun **o'ziga** chiroyli ko'ylak sotib oldi.

sentences.text: James introduced **himself** to everyone at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Jeyms majlisda hammaga **o'zini** tanishtirdi.

sentences.text: When she saw the old photo, my mum didn't recognise **herself**.
sentences.translation: Eski suratni ko'rganda, oyim **o'zini** tanimadi.

sentences.text: We introduced **ourselves** to the new neighbours.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilarga **o'zimizni** tanishtirdik.

sentences.text: Children, please behave **yourselves** while I'm out.
sentences.translation: Bolalar, men yo'qligimda **o'zingizni** yaxshi tutinglar.

sentences.text: The players were angry with **themselves** after the match.
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin o'yinchilarning **o'zlaridan** jahli chiqdi.

sentences.text: Did you make these posters **yourselves**?
sentences.translation: Bu plakatlarni **o'zlaringiz** yasadingizmi?

sentences.text: My parents bought **themselves** a small house by the sea.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **o'zlariga** dengiz bo'yida kichik uy sotib olishdi.

sentences.text: Nobody else is guilty; we only have **ourselves** to blame.
sentences.translation: Boshqa hech kim aybdor emas, faqat **o'zimiz** aybdormiz.

sentences.text: Students, look at **yourselves** in the video — you were great!
sentences.translation: Talabalar, videoda **o'zingizga** qarang — ajoyib edingiz!

sentences.text: The tourists took photos of **themselves** in front of the Registan.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar Registon oldida **o'zlarini** suratga olishdi.

sentences.text: Be careful, boys, or you'll hurt **yourselves**!
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'linglar, bolalar, aks holda **o'zlaringizni** jarohatlab olasizlar!

sentences.text: During the trip we cooked for **ourselves** every evening.
sentences.translation: Sayohat davomida har kuni kechqurun ovqatni **o'zimiz** pishirdik.

examples.title: Set phrases: **enjoy yourself**, **help yourself**
examples.description: Tayyor iboralar: **enjoy yourself** (maza qilib dam oling), **help yourself** (oling, tortinmang), **make yourself at home**, **behave yourself**, **introduce yourself**.

sentences.text: Have a great trip and **enjoy yourselves**!
sentences.translation: Safaringiz yaxshi o'tsin, **maza qilib dam olinglar**!

sentences.text: Please **help yourself** to fruit and sweets.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, meva va shirinliklardan **oling, tortinmang**.

sentences.text: Come in and **make yourself at home**.
sentences.translation: Kiring, **o'z uyingizdek bo'ling**.

sentences.text: Did you **enjoy yourself** at the concert last night?
sentences.translation: Kechagi konsertda **yaxshi dam oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: Let me **introduce myself**: I'm Bekzod, the new manager.
sentences.translation: **O'zimni tanishtirsam**: men Bekzod, yangi menejerman.

sentences.text: **Behave yourself** in the museum, Timur — don't touch anything!
sentences.translation: Muzeyda **o'zingni yaxshi tut**, Temur — hech narsaga tegma!

sentences.text: Bye, Mum! — Goodbye, darling, **take care of yourself**.
sentences.translation: Xayr, oyi! — Xayr, jonim, **o'zingni ehtiyot qil**.

sentences.text: The water is very hot, so don't **burn yourself**.
sentences.translation: Suv juda issiq, **kuyib qolmang**.

sentences.text: On holiday we **enjoyed ourselves** so much that we didn't want to come home.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilda shunchalik **maza qildikki**, uyga qaytgimiz kelmadi.

sentences.text: There's plenty of food, so please **help yourselves**, everyone!
sentences.translation: Ovqat ko'p, marhamat, hammangiz **olinglar, tortinmanglar**!

examples.title: Emphasis: I did it **myself**
examples.description: Gap oxiridagi yoki otdan keyingi **myself**, **himself** ... — «o'zim», «o'zi» (boshqa birov emas). O'zbekchada ham: «xonani **o'zim** bo'yadim».

sentences.text: I painted the kitchen **myself** — it took two days.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani **o'zim** bo'yadim — ikki kun ketdi.

sentences.text: Did you make this cake **yourself**? It's delicious!
sentences.translation: Bu tortni **o'zingiz** pishirdingizmi? Juda mazali!

sentences.text: The mayor **himself** came to open the new park.
sentences.translation: Yangi bog'ni ochishga hokimning **o'zi** keldi.

sentences.text: Madina designed and made her wedding dress **herself**.
sentences.translation: Madina to'y ko'ylagini **o'zi** chizib, **o'zi** tikdi.

sentences.text: We don't need a builder; we can fix the roof **ourselves**.
sentences.translation: Bizga usta kerak emas, tomni **o'zimiz** tuzata olamiz.

sentences.text: Why don't you ask the manager **herself**?
sentences.translation: Nega menejerning **o'zidan** so'ramaysiz?

sentences.text: My grandfather built this house **himself** in 1975.
sentences.translation: Bu uyni bobom 1975-yilda **o'zi** qurgan.

sentences.text: If you want something done well, do it **yourself**.
sentences.translation: Ish yaxshi bajarilishini istasangiz, uni **o'zingiz** qiling.

sentences.text: The film **itself** was boring, but the music was wonderful.
sentences.translation: Filmning **o'zi** zerikarli edi, lekin musiqasi ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: The children planted all these trees **themselves**.
sentences.translation: Bu daraxtlarning hammasini bolalar **o'zlari** ekishgan.

examples.title: **by myself**: alone, without help
examples.description: **by myself / by herself** ... — «yolg'iz» yoki «hech kimning yordamisiz, o'zi». **by itself** — «o'z-o'zidan».

sentences.text: My grandmother lives **by herself** in a big house.
sentences.translation: Buvim katta uyda **yolg'iz** yashaydi.

sentences.text: Can you get home **by yourself**, or shall I come with you?
sentences.translation: Uyga **o'zingiz** bora olasizmi yoki birga boraymi?

sentences.text: I don't like eating **by myself** in restaurants.
sentences.translation: Restoranlarda **yolg'iz** ovqatlanishni yoqtirmayman.

sentences.text: Our son is only four, but he can get dressed **by himself**.
sentences.translation: O'g'limiz bor-yo'g'i to'rt yoshda, lekin **o'zi** kiyina oladi.

sentences.text: Sarah travelled around Asia **by herself** for six months.
sentences.translation: Sara olti oy davomida Osiyo bo'ylab **yolg'iz** sayohat qildi.

sentences.text: Don't leave the baby **by himself** in the bath.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloqni vannada **yolg'iz** qoldirmang.

sentences.text: The door opened **by itself** — it was only the wind.
sentences.translation: Eshik **o'z-o'zidan** ochildi — shamol ekan.

sentences.text: We moved all the furniture **by ourselves**, without any help.
sentences.translation: Hamma mebelni **o'zimiz**, hech kimning yordamisiz ko'chirdik.

sentences.text: Is Emma coming with friends? — No, she's coming **by herself**.
sentences.translation: Emma do'stlari bilan keladimi? — Yo'q, **yolg'iz** keladi.

sentences.text: When I was a student in Oxford, I lived **by myself** for the first time.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda talaba bo'lganimda, birinchi marta **yolg'iz** yashadim.

examples.title: **themselves** or **each other**?
examples.description: **each other** — «bir-birini, bir-biriga»; **themselves / ourselves** — har biri «o'zini». Adashtirsangiz, ma'no butunlay o'zgaradi.

sentences.text: Aziz and Lola love **each other** very much.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Lola **bir-birini** juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Tom and Emma looked at **each other** and smiled.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Emma **bir-biriga** qarab jilmayishdi.

sentences.text: The two boys blamed **each other** for the broken window.
sentences.translation: Ikki bola singan deraza uchun **bir-birini** ayblashdi.

sentences.text: After the accident, both drivers blamed **themselves**.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan keyin ikkala haydovchi ham **o'zini** aybladi.

sentences.text: We've known **each other** since primary school.
sentences.translation: **Bir-birimizni** boshlang'ich maktabdan beri taniymiz.

sentences.text: My sisters often borrow **each other's** clothes.
sentences.translation: Opa-singillarim tez-tez **bir-birining** kiyimini kiyib turishadi.

sentences.text: The students introduced **themselves** and then interviewed **each other**.
sentences.translation: Talabalar avval **o'zlarini** tanishtirishdi, keyin **bir-biridan** intervyu olishdi.

sentences.text: Do you and your brother help **each other** with homework?
sentences.translation: Akang ikkalangiz uy vazifasida **bir-biringizga** yordam berasizlarmi?

sentences.text: Madina and Dilnoza write to **each other** every week.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Dilnoza har hafta **bir-biriga** xat yozishadi.

sentences.text: Look at those two cats — they're washing **themselves**, not **each other**.
sentences.translation: Anavi ikki mushukka qarang — ular **bir-birini** emas, **o'zlarini** yalayapti.

examples.title: Mixed: with and without **-self**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: -self, by myself, each other va **-self siz** fe'llar (feel, relax, get dressed, shave, meet) — o'zbekchada «o'zimni» bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: I got up late, **had a quick shower** and **got dressed** in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Kech turdim, tezda **cho'mildim** va besh daqiqada **kiyindim**.

sentences.text: How do you **feel** today? — Much better, thanks.
sentences.translation: Bugun **o'zingizni** qanday **his qilyapsiz**? — Ancha yaxshi, rahmat.

sentences.text: Sit down and **relax** — dinner will be ready in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: O'tiring, **dam oling** — kechki ovqat o'n daqiqada tayyor bo'ladi.

sentences.text: James **shaves** every morning, but at the weekend he doesn't bother.
sentences.translation: Jeyms har kuni ertalab **soqol oladi**, dam olish kunlari esa erinadi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza taught **herself** French, and now she works in Paris.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza fransuz tilini **o'zi** o'rgandi, endi Parijda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Sardor phone **each other** almost every day.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan Sardor deyarli har kuni **bir-biriga** qo'ng'iroq qilishadi.

sentences.text: Be careful on the ice — you might hurt **yourself**.
sentences.translation: Muz ustida ehtiyot bo'ling — **lat yeb qolishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: We **met** in 2015 and got married two years later.
sentences.translation: Biz 2015-yilda **tanishdik** va ikki yildan keyin turmush qurdik.

sentences.text: After the long walk, the children **helped themselves** to sandwiches.
sentences.translation: Uzoq sayrdan keyin bolalar sendvichlardan **olib yeyishdi**.

sentences.text: Living **by yourself** is hard at first, but you learn to look after **yourself**.
sentences.translation: **Yolg'iz** yashash avvaliga qiyin, lekin asta-sekin **o'zingizga** qarashni o'rganasiz.
